water.name: Land
water.rule: At least 4 of the hex's 7 sample points (centre + 6) fall in a NUTS 3 region or a neighbouring country (GISCO outlines), unless the centre is sea and the ETOPO1 mean is at or below sea level, or at least half its ETOPO1 samples are (bays and estuaries stay water).

water.name: Ocean
water.rule: Sea deeper than 200 m and not next to land.

water.name: Coast
water.rule: Sea next to a land hex, or shallower than 200 m (ETOPO1 mean).

water.name: Lake
water.rule: Water hex (most of its 7 sample points off land) with Natural Earth 1:10m lake points that outnumber sea points, or above sea level.

relief.name: Flat
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation inside the hex under 55 m.

relief.name: Mountains
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation ≥ 190 m, or mean elevation ≥ 1,500 m.

cover.name: None
cover.rule: Water, a neighbouring country, or no land pixel.

cover.name: Broadleaf forest
cover.rule: Forest (311+312+313) dominates and broadleaf (311) is its largest part.

cover.name: Coniferous forest
cover.rule: Forest dominates and conifers (312) are its largest part.

cover.name: Mixed forest
cover.rule: Forest dominates and mixed forest (313) is its largest part.

cover.name: Heath and scrub
cover.rule: Moors, heathland, maquis, garrigue and transitional woodland (322, 323, 324, 334) dominate.

cover.name: Grassland
cover.rule: Natural grassland, sparse vegetation (321, 333) and green urban areas (141, 142) dominate.

cover.name: Pasture and mixed farming
cover.rule: Pastures (231), complex cultivation patterns, farmland with natural areas and agro-forestry (242, 243, 244) dominate.

cover.name: Cropland
cover.rule: Arable land, rice fields, vineyards, orchards, olive groves and associated annual crops (211-223, 241) dominate.

cover.name: Wetland
cover.rule: Marshes, peat bogs, salines and intertidal flats (411-423) dominate.

cover.name: Urban
cover.rule: Built-up land (111-133) covers at least 30% of the hex's land, whatever else there is.

cover.name: Rock and sand
cover.rule: Bare rock, beaches and dunes, mineral extraction (331, 332, 131) dominate.

notes.water: GISCO's 1:3 million outlines and ETOPO1 do not meet exactly. A sea hex whose ETOPO1 mean is above sea level (and with fewer than half its samples below) becomes land when at least 4 of its 6 neighbours are land, or when it touches both a map country and a neighbouring country; it takes its neighbours' majority owner. Reservoirs narrower than half a hex stay land and their river crosses them. A sea hex's elevation is the mean of its ETOPO1 samples below sea level (its depth).
notes.relief: From ETOPO1 points (one every two arc-minutes, about 3.7 km, some thirty per hex) at or above -100 m, so bays and sea floor do not count; all points are used if none qualifies. Water hexes are always flat.
notes.cover: From OpenGeoHub's 2018 land-cover map in the CORINE nomenclature (its ~480 m overview), sampled on a ~800 m lattice in every hex of the map's countries (about 400 points), and CORINE Land Cover 2018 for the French overseas regions. Water (511-523) and no-data pixels are ignored; shares are of the remaining land points, rounded to the percent, and the urban threshold applies to the rounded built-up share. Neighbouring countries (United Kingdom, Turkey, Ukraine…) have no land cover (0).
